title: I Built A Tool That Tracks Insider Trading
author: Few-Station3025
selftext:
**5 years ago** when i came across DFV and Insider Trading and ive been using it as part of my analysis every since.

(and its been working pretty well im up **45% in the past year on my TFSA**)

But openinsider always just felt laggy, missed a lot of filters and you always had to keep checking it since there wasnt an alert option.

So earlier this year i decided to build [kestrelterminal](http://kestrelterminal.com/) as a side project for personal use to do exactly what openinsider couldnt.

If any of yall are interested in **free access** just lmk and ill give you a  **code** to try it out.

It would mean a lot if you checked it out, and let me know if theres any changes I can make or improvements youd might like.

[kestrelterminal.com](http://kestrelterminal.com/)

comments.author: SuperOrbital_Trading
comments.body: I don't really pay attention to this as most of my assets are long term, and the other side of my investing is 0dte trading so I don't think it would help me. I just love seeing all the new creations and ideas people are coming up with. AI making coding accessible to the masses is sparking so many new creations. Good work. However, isn't all this data routinely available through brokers already?

replies.author: Few-Station3025
replies.body: thanks man, and yeah all the data is "public". Most brokers dont usually lay it out tho (atleast not properly). Robinhood is the best but its still lacking and most other brokers just show pure data and its super hard to sort through. Our software doesnt just allow you to sort through the data so you can make sense of the noise. But also has a custom built strategy that alerts you of certain trades that meet X ammount of requirements that we've found to return the best performance
